reviews.play_chase: VALID framing. Three explore reviews: REVISE. Hitch still wins panel language and hardware density at D=144. Flank D2/02 and extra plate course added. Well is a rimmed hole; greenhouse is a cage over a cut tub. Rejected UV-spray/megatex, seat asks, and 'rebuild as voxel loft'.
reviews.play_chase_abeam: VALID framing. Hull-side D2/02 plus winglet glyphs read. Well mouth empty. Hitch still denser on manufactured meso.
reviews.play_chase_close: VALID framing. Lower plate course, thicker hoses, split trays both sides, vent banks. Well is a hole with small crates; greenhouse glass in the tub. Hitch still wins D=144 density.

notes: C4 grew chase-scale plates, abeam stencil, hardware, and dirt. Hitch still wins overall chase density at D=144. No seats. No megatex. Hitch/Kestrel/Hornet frozen. Parent unproven / not G7.
